title: mut.feedback
mutation_directive: GOOD DIRECTION (differential-growth 3D calligraphic-ink) — but the point geometry is unclear/blurry. Fix sharpness: (1) replace PointsMaterial with CatmullRomCurve3 + TubeGeometry swept along the growth skeleton — this is the preferred ink/vascular technique in this project and gives crisp, readable edge definition. (2) If staying with Points, switch to AlphaTest ≥ 0.5 + hard-edge circle texture (no gaussian falloff), disable sizeAttenuation, reduce point size until each node reads as a distinct mark. (3) No additive blending on the main form — it causes bloom-blur; use NormalBlending with opacity ≥ 0.85. Goal: the calligraphic 'ink' strokes should be LEGIBLE as individual marks, like brushwork, not a smeared fog.

threejs_review.directive: Replace per-frond chain traversal with GPU instancing: use InstancedMesh (one sphere/capsule per node) or BatchedMesh for all nodes, then draw connectivity as a single LineSegments with fat lines (webgl_lines_fat). This eliminates hundreds of individual tube geometries and yields crisp, scalable geometry at 4000+ nodes.
